what_this_is: F-8b's receipt: the rebuilt corpus with the 604 held-out-contaminated fenrir rows removed, and the refusal share re-solved against the new denominator.

authority.decision: the 2026-10-24 programme ruling: no human validation is available, so the model's own judgement stands in; the programme must reach the goal.
authority.treatment: A of docs/ESCALATION-F8-HELDOUT-CONTAMINATION.md — remove the rows and re-derive.
authority.why_a: only A decontaminates the corpus; B retires the only programme-owned instrument instead of fixing the data; C measures without fixing. A changes no bar, metric, parser, sample size, decode budget or label, and it is reversible in one command — the removal set names every removed row by its normalised prompt hash.

removal.cross_check: the count is asserted against f8-decontamination-report.json's own holdout_rows_present_by_prompt_hash
removal.reversible: re-running this script without the removal restores the input corpus byte-for-byte; the removal set names every removed row's normalised prompt hash

refusal_share.target_parameter_source: eval-2026-10-23/c5_refusal_policy.py::TARGET_SHARE, read from the file, not restated here
refusal_share.policy: docs/REFUSAL-POLICY.md (decision W-3) — the SHARE is the invariant, not the presentation count

not_the_final_corpus: this is the decontaminated WORKING corpus. The Data Gate receipt (D-7) is still outstanding, now on a model-adjudicated basis; until it is issued, no training is valid against it.
